sections.title: Negative prefixes
sections.content:
Prefixes that create opposite or negative meanings:
• un-: unable, unusual, unfair. The decision was completely unfair.
• dis-: disagree, disapprove, disconnect. I strongly disagree with that statement.
• mis-: misunderstand, mislead, misinterpret. Don't misinterpret my silence as agreement.
• in-/im-/il-/ir-: invisible, impossible, illegal, irregular. It's impossible to finish by tomorrow.
• over-: overestimate, overreact, overcharge. People often overestimate their abilities.

sections.title: Other useful prefixes
sections.content:
Prefixes that modify meaning in various ways:
• re-: redo, reconsider, rebuild. We had to rebuild the entire system.
• pre-: preview, predict, prejudge. Don't prejudge people based on appearance.
• under-: underestimate, underpaid, underperform. Never underestimate the power of practice.
• co-: cooperate, co-exist, co-author. The two species co-exist peacefully in the forest.
• multi-: multilingual, multicultural, multitask. Being multilingual is a huge advantage in business.

exercises.question: The prefix meaning 'wrongly' is:
exercises.explanation: The prefix mis- means wrongly or incorrectly.

exercises.question: Which prefix means 'too much'?
exercises.explanation: The prefix over- means too much or excessively.

exercises.question: The prefix 're-' means:
exercises.explanation: The prefix re- means again or back.

exercises.question: Which word means 'not legal'?
exercises.explanation: Illegal uses the prefix il- (variant of in-) before words starting with 'l'.

exercises.question: 'Underestimate' means to:
exercises.explanation: Underestimate means to estimate something to be smaller or less important than it actually is.

exercises.question: The prefix 'pre-' means:
exercises.explanation: The prefix pre- means before in time or order.

exercises.question: Which prefix means 'together' or 'jointly'?
exercises.explanation: The prefix co- means together, jointly, or mutually.

exercises.question: A person who speaks many languages is:
exercises.explanation: Multilingual means able to speak several languages.
